title: Add a structured binary document payload (kind 2) to ThreeMD 2.1 in Swift, TypeScript and Rust, with fast checksums, CLI binary support and a performance gate
description: Add a structured binary document payload (kind 2) to ThreeMD 2.1 in Swift, TypeScript and Rust, with fast checksums, CLI binary support and a performance gate
acceptance_criteria: ThreeMD 2.1 stores a Document as payload kind 2 (structured binary) inside the unchanged 3mdb version 1 container, specified in SPEC.md section 11.3. Swift, TypeScript and Rust write byte-identical kind-2 files and decode them to exactly the Document that decoding the same canonical text yields; validity equals the 2.0 canonical-text validation under the same limits (differential fuzz with zero disagreements). DocumentStorageFormat.binary writes kind 2, encodeTextContainer writes the 2.0 kind-1 bytes, every committed 2.0 .3mdb stays readable byte-unchanged, and 2.0 readers fail cleanly with unsupportedPayloadKind(2). Kind-2 decode is at least 4x faster than bounded text decode and faster than the legacy parser in all three languages, kind-1 decode is within 10% of bounded text decode thanks to a fast CRC, and a CI performance gate enforces this. The threemd CLI reads .3mdb, converts between text and binary and inspects containers. Keys are ordered by raw UTF-8 bytes, a lowered maximumDecodedBytes still bounds decompression, and Rust canonical numbers round-trip for all powers of two. The nine-pair interchange gate covers kind 2 and kind 1, Linux and macOS suites pass, pinned Trust 1.2.2 and strict SpecSync pass on the exact tip, and 2.1.0 is released. Compositions keep the readable profile; payload kind 3 is reserved.
